description: Redstick's record filtered by job, trade, kind, country sold in, maker's country or connected system, each tool in full with its dated log of changes. Paid per call by x402 in USDC: $0.05 a call including the first 10 tools returned, then $0.02 for each further tool (the most a call can cost, at 200 tools, is $3.850); set limit to hold the cost. The exact price is stated before anything is paid. A call that cannot be answered as asked, or that finds nothing, is free.

country.description: two-letter country code where the tool is sold, e.g. GB

maker_country.description: the maker's country by name, e.g. Germany
